blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Cebu City’s barangays are coming together for the 2026 Mayor’s Cup basketball and volleyball tournaments, which opened on Saturday, November 7. The tournament opened in the Cebu City Sports Center but will be played in multiple venues until the first week of December. It highlights Mayor Nestor Archival’s commitment to grassroots sports development and providing more opportunities for residents to stay active. Mayor Archival said that the tournament’s significance goes beyond sports.
